detail.description: UnGodly just launched worldwide. From the creator of Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes comes a dark fantasy RPG where one hero swap can turn a boss fight. Clip the moment worth replaying. Earn up to $175 per clip, with a chance at a $500 bonus for passing 1M eligible views.
detail.name: UnGodly Mobile RPG | Boss Fights & Clutch Plays

content.guidelines:
• The clip: Drop us into the fight. Show the boss winding up, the dodge that barely lands, or the hero swap that saves the run. Give us the payoff in 12–30 seconds. Go vertical, put “UnGodly” on screen, and make the edit yours.

• Footage: Use Azra-supplied footage or your own UnGodly gameplay. For combat with mobile controls visible, see 1:00–1:22 in the official B-roll.

• Branding: Fonts, colors, logos, and end cards are optional. If you use a logo, use the supplied file.

• Audience: Only verified views from the US, UK, EU member countries, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, The Bahamas, Guyana, and Barbados count toward payouts and the 1M-view bonus. Views from India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh earn $0.

• Disclosure: put #ad at the end of caption (not on video)

• Audio: Use your own voice or any music cleared for Azra’s paid ads, including free or trending tracks.

• Eligibility: Organic views only. No bought views, boosts, bots, engagement swaps, or duplicate submissions.

• Analytics must be shared as a SCREEN RECORDING from the native app. Screenshots not accepted for bonus claims.

• Usage rights: By submitting, you allow Azra to repost your clip and use it in paid ads, including your voice or on-camera appearance.

•Corrections: Complete any requested fix or takedown within 24 hours.

JOIN THE UNGODLY DISCORD: https://discord.com/invite/ungodly

detail.description: Clip Mack Camferdam's Minecraft Hardcore streams (plus Ready or Not and NBA 2K) for TikTok. Short, high-stakes moments: deaths, close calls, rage, big reactions. Raw clips are linked in the reference materials - take them, cut them, post them. Paid per 1,000 views.
detail.name: Mack Camferdam - Twitch Clips

content.guidelines:
Keep my facecam in frame the whole time. The reaction is the content, not the gameplay.
Burn the caption into the top third: white text, black outline, big enough to read on a phone.
9:16 vertical, full screen, bright and readable. No letterboxing, no borders, no zoom-outs.
No watermarks from other apps and no other streamers' overlays or names in frame.
Put "Mack_Camferdam on Twitch" in the TikTok description and tag @mack.camferdam.
Do not open on a menu, a mod list, or a loading screen.

creator.description: Gaming clippers who already post short-form on TikTok and understand hooks. You should be comfortable pulling raw Twitch clips, cutting them down to 5-9 seconds, and burning in captions that read clean on a phone. Minecraft Hardcore, horror and FPS clipping experience is a plus. I care about retention, not volume - one clip people watch to the end beats three they scroll past.
